slides.title:
'It pings' is not
an acceptance test.
slides.body:
It's a pulse check on a patient
nobody has *examined*.

slides.title: 1 — The application
slides.body:
Not that the circuit is up.
That the thing it *exists for*
completes.

slides.title: Why
slides.body:
A link can be perfect
while the service behind it
is *unusable*.

slides.title: 3 — The failure case
slides.body:
Deliberately *triggered*.
Take the primary path away
and measure what the user sees.

slides.title: Not convergence
slides.body:
Not whether the route converges.
Whether the *transaction*
completes.

slides.title: 4 — Real load
slides.body:
At the hour that matters.
A test at 7am measures
an *empty network*.

slides.title: 5 — A named signer
slides.body:
Not a team.
Not a mailbox.
Somebody who could say *no*.

slides.title: What they share
steps: A criterion that cannot fail is not a criterion.
It is a *sentence in a document*.

slides.title:
The test isn't there to prove
the project *finished*.
slides.body:
It's so that later,
when something is wrong,
you can tell if it was ever right.
